title: Avoid indexed LinkedList traversal
why: LinkedList.get walks from an end of the list, so repeated indexed access in a loop can make traversal quadratic.
suggestion: Iterate with an enhanced for loop or Iterator, or use an ArrayList when indexed access is required.
limitations: Only directly declared LinkedList variables accessed with get inside braced loops are reported.
Aliases, reassignment, collection size, and bounded loop counts are not inferred.
